name: Candida krusei / Pichia kudriavzevii

syndromes.title: Invasive disease / candidaemia
rows: ANID 200 mg LD → 100 mg/day; CASPO 70 mg LD → 50 mg/day (70 mg/day if >80 kg per table); MICA 100 mg/day; REZA 400 mg LD → 200 mg weekly
For uncomplicated candidaemia: minimum 14 days after documented bloodstream clearance AND resolution of attributable symptoms; longer for deep/endovascular disease.
A I at Candida-genus level; not species-specific evidence
Cornely 2025 Candidiasis | genus-level candidaemia treatment (Table 29 / Fig 11–13, PDF pp93–100); taxonomy: Supplement Table 1, PDF p14
Reassess response; step-down/maintenance if specified for this syndrome

Species identification and EUCAST/CLSI susceptibility testing are strongly recommended for severe/invasive infection. This row applies the genus-level candidaemia recommendation to this species card; it should not be interpreted as species-specific A I evidence.
Fluconazole or voriconazole only if susceptible and clinical criteria met
Total course for uncomplicated candidaemia: minimum 14 days after documented bloodstream clearance AND symptom resolution; species-specific susceptibility and step-down criteria still apply.
